sloka: अपरं किन्तु कृत्वायं विधानं संविधास्यति ।कौतूहलसमुत्पन्नो यास्यामि यमसादनम् ।। ७.२०.३२ ॥
transliteration: aparaṁ kintu kṛtvāyaṁ vidhānaṁ saṁvidhāsyati ।kautūhalasamutpanno yāsyāmi yamasādanam ।। 7.20.32 ॥

translations.english: How will he conquer him who is the ordainer and sustainer of both good and bad deeds, and by whom the three worlds are already subdued?
